title: Komira's Locket

sources.title: Dancing Lights
markers: | summary = It creates magical orbs of light that brighten an area.

sources.title: Dancing Lights (area)
markers: | summary = an [[area]] created by {{SAI|Dancing Lights}}. It creates an area of bright, magical light that illuminates the dark.

sources.title: Save Arabella
markers: | description = Save Arabella is a quest available in the Emerald Grove, and begins when nearing the Sacred Pool. Kagha, acting leader of the druids, is holding a tiefling child captive. Her parents want to make sure she is okay.

summary: Cast Dancing Lights as an Action while wearing the locket.

fields.Dancing Lights: Action. Target a point up to 60 ft away and illuminate a 30 ft radius for up to 10 turns with Concentration. Move the lights as a Bonus Action. The item grants a per-turn recharge.
fields.Acquisition: Komira and Locke reward the party after it saves Arabella from Kagha.
fields.Base value: 65 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
